name: What should I do to prepare my home for patio door glass replacement?
description: Clear the work area, remove fragile items, and secure pets to ensure a smooth and safe installation process.

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for patio door glass replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for patio door glass replacement, clear the area around the door, both inside and out, to allow ample working space for our technicians. Remove any valuable or fragile items from the vicinity to prevent accidental damage. If the door leads to a pet area, plan to secure your pets during the installation process to ensure their safety and prevent them from interfering with the work. Consider these steps for a smooth installation experience in areas like Fremont or San Leandro.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the work area, remove fragile items, and secure pets to ensure a smooth and safe installation process.
